001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.jfr;
002
003import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
004
005import jdk.jfr.Category;
006import jdk.jfr.Description;
007import jdk.jfr.Enabled;
008import jdk.jfr.Event;
009import jdk.jfr.Label;
010import jdk.jfr.Name;
011import jdk.jfr.StackTrace;
012
013/**
014 * Base JFR event committed by {@link JfrAlertListener}, one concrete subclass per SLF4J /
015 * {@link java.lang.System.Logger.Level}, deliberately a <strong>separate</strong> JFR
016 * event type family from {@link RainbowGumLogEvent} (same field shape and per-level
017 * split, but its own {@code @Name}s) even though both are committed the same way and
018 * carry the same fields: an alert (an appender failing to write, an async publisher's
019 * queue overflowing, etc.) is not an application log line, and merging the two under one
020 * event name would make it impossible to tell them apart in a recording - e.g. filtering
021 * {@code jfr print --events io.jstach.rainbowgum.Error} would return both genuine
022 * application errors and RainbowGum's own internal alerts with no way to distinguish
023 * them.
024 * <p>
025 * See {@link RainbowGumLogEvent} for the field/annotation rationale - identical here.
026 */
027@Category("Rainbow Gum")
028@StackTrace(false)
029public abstract sealed class RainbowGumAlertEvent extends Event {
030
031        /**
032         * The already-formatted alert message, or null if there was none.
033         */
034        @Label("Message")
035        public @Nullable String message;
036
037        /**
038         * The logger name, or null if unavailable.
039         */
040        @Label("Logger")
041        public @Nullable String logger;
042
043        /**
044         * The alert's throwable formatted as a stack trace string, or null if none was
045         * logged.
046         */
047        @Label("Throwable")
048        public @Nullable String throwable;
049
050        RainbowGumAlertEvent() {
051        }
052
053        /**
054         * Creates the concrete event subclass matching {@code level}, or null if there is
055         * none (JFR events are all-or-nothing per level, not filterable by
056         * {@link java.lang.System.Logger.Level#ALL}/{@link java.lang.System.Logger.Level#OFF}).
057         * @param level level.
058         * @return new, uncommitted event instance, or null.
059         */
060        static @Nullable RainbowGumAlertEvent of(java.lang.System.Logger.Level level) {
061                return switch (level) {
062                        case TRACE -> new TraceEvent();
063                        case DEBUG -> new DebugEvent();
064                        case INFO -> new InfoEvent();
065                        case WARNING -> new WarnEvent();
066                        case ERROR -> new ErrorEvent();
067                        case ALL, OFF -> null;
068                };
069        }
070
071        /**
072         * TRACE level alert. Disabled by default ({@link Enabled @Enabled(false)}), same
073         * volume reasoning as {@link RainbowGumLogEvent.TraceEvent}.
074         */
075        @Name("io.jstach.rainbowgum.AlertTrace")
076        @Label("Alert (Trace)")
077        @Description("A TRACE level Rainbow Gum alert.")
078        @Enabled(false)
079        public static final class TraceEvent extends RainbowGumAlertEvent {
080
081                /**
082                 * Created by {@link JfrAlertListener}.
083                 */
084                TraceEvent() {
085                }
086
087        }
088
089        /**
090         * DEBUG level alert. Disabled by default ({@link Enabled @Enabled(false)}), same
091         * volume reasoning as {@link RainbowGumLogEvent.DebugEvent}.
092         */
093        @Name("io.jstach.rainbowgum.AlertDebug")
094        @Label("Alert (Debug)")
095        @Description("A DEBUG level Rainbow Gum alert.")
096        @Enabled(false)
097        public static final class DebugEvent extends RainbowGumAlertEvent {
098
099                /**
100                 * Created by {@link JfrAlertListener}.
101                 */
102                DebugEvent() {
103                }
104
105        }
106
107        /**
108         * INFO level alert.
109         */
110        @Name("io.jstach.rainbowgum.AlertInfo")
111        @Label("Alert (Info)")
112        @Description("An INFO level Rainbow Gum alert.")
113        public static final class InfoEvent extends RainbowGumAlertEvent {
114
115                /**
116                 * Created by {@link JfrAlertListener}.
117                 */
118                InfoEvent() {
119                }
120
121        }
122
123        /**
124         * WARN level alert.
125         */
126        @Name("io.jstach.rainbowgum.AlertWarn")
127        @Label("Alert (Warn)")
128        @Description("A WARN level Rainbow Gum alert.")
129        public static final class WarnEvent extends RainbowGumAlertEvent {
130
131                /**
132                 * Created by {@link JfrAlertListener}.
133                 */
134                WarnEvent() {
135                }
136
137        }
138
139        /**
140         * ERROR level alert.
141         */
142        @Name("io.jstach.rainbowgum.AlertError")
143        @Label("Alert (Error)")
144        @Description("An ERROR level Rainbow Gum alert.")
145        public static final class ErrorEvent extends RainbowGumAlertEvent {
146
147                /**
148                 * Created by {@link JfrAlertListener}.
149                 */
150                ErrorEvent() {
151                }
152
153        }
154
155}
